headline: Adversarial speculative decoding routes important reasoning through higher precision
summary: A Nov 3 preprint proposes adversarial speculative decoding: train a draft model to make selected reasoning-decision tokens more likely to be rejected, so exact residual sampling by the target writes those tokens at the first slot of a new verification block. The paper reports increased numerical precision at early slots, long-horizon coding-agent gains on GLM-5.3-NVFP4 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and up to roughly 2% decoding-speed cost. These are author-reported experiments on two serving configurations; independent reproduction and broader transfer are not established.
